figures.alt: A defined case population is sampled into language, appliance, risk, and evidence-condition trays, with covered and missing intersections visibly marked.
figures.evidenceRole: Explains declared coverage and visible gaps without reporting population frequency.

figures.alt: Evaluation cases move from authorized source through annotation, family-aware split, freeze, refresh, and retirement behind leakage barriers.
figures.evidenceRole: Explains leakage-aware lifecycle controls without claiming contamination is fully detectable.

figures.alt: One error specimen connects to separate criterion, consequence, severity, detectability, segment, control, and disposition records.
figures.evidenceRole: Separates error fields without defining a universal severity scale.

figures.alt: Judgment escalates from deterministic check to reference, grader, human, domain specialist, and accountable authority as ambiguity and consequence increase.
figures.evidenceRole: Shows judgment escalation and retained disagreement without treating any judge as infallible.

figures.alt: Baseline and candidate systems share frozen controls while one unlocked variable is compared across paired cases, repeated trials, and segment lenses.
figures.evidenceRole: Explains controlled comparison without claiming causality beyond the experiment design.

figures.alt: Experiment evidence, regressions, uncertainty, and confounds enter retain, revise, reject, scope, or release disposition gates.
figures.evidenceRole: Connects evidence to explicit disposition while preserving release as an authority handoff.

limitations: Mosaic Desk cases, judgments, experiment results, regressions, and dispositions are fictional and synthetic.
The evaluation-set fixture demonstrates provenance, segmentation, family-aware splits, gaps, and version identity; it proves no target-population representativeness or freedom from contamination.
The judgment fixture exposes deterministic position and verbosity biases for teaching; it does not estimate any live judge's accuracy or transfer domain authority.
The experiment fixture demonstrates isolation, paired evidence, segment regressions, hard gates, and disposition logic; it reports no live-model quality, latency, or causal outcome.
Figure records are semantic anchors only; root owns ImageGen production.
